up: Retrieve compounds that have at least one activity entry associated with the document CHEMBL5725984. Return the compound's ChEMBL ID (CHEMBL_id) and the document ID (doc_id) for the source publication. Optionally include any activity identifier or record identifier if present in the data; otherwise, only the two identifiers are required. Ensure results reflect compounds that have been recorded in the specified document, regardless of assay type or activity type.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno AS molregno, a.doc_id AS doc_id FROM activities a WHERE a.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725984')
